title: A complete solution to the Tokushige measure conjecture and its stability
summary: We resolve three conjectures proposed by Tokushige in 2013 about cross $t$-intersecting families of subsets and integer sequences. For $0 (1-\varepsilon)^2(p_1p_2)^t$, then there exists $T\in\binom{[n]}{t}$ such that $μ_{p_i}(\mathcal F_i\mathbin{\triangle}\mathcal S_T)<C\varepsilon$ for $i=1,2$, where $C$ depends only on $t,p_1,p_2$. This improves Tokushige's conjectured $C\sqrt{\varepsilon}$ estimate to $C\varepsilon$.
